external_primary_evidence.fact: After fork, child file descriptors refer to the same open file descriptions as the corresponding parent descriptors; flock/open-file-description lock state is inherited.
flock locks are associated with an open file description and duplicate descriptors created by fork refer to the same lock.
Python exposes after-in-child fork callbacks for resetting process-local runtime state after fork.
External resources need validated fencing/version identity beyond lock possession, and restored snapshots can require revision/incarnation invalidation semantics.

leading_hypothesis: PR #228 exact-object Gate issuance is not process-incarnation-safe: Linux fork may clone the WeakSet/WeakKeyDictionary capability state while inheriting the same flock-backed open file description, allowing a child to appear to own the same transient effect execution capability without a fresh Gate acquisition.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Existing exact V15/V16 admission, ingress ownership, object identity and provider-commit checks already invalidate a forked child before effect B2/B3, so the copied process-local state is insufficient for effect authority.

architecture_delta.name: PROCESS_INCARNATION_BOUND_EXECUTION_CAPABILITY
candidate_rules_if_target_oob_reproduces: A Gate-issued execution capability is valid only in the process incarnation that issued it.
Forked children inherit no effect execution authority from parent process-local registries, secrets or inherited file descriptors.
At-fork child handling must invalidate/reseed transient capability state without unlocking the parent's shared flock open-file-description.
B1/B2/B3 must fail closed when current process incarnation differs from the issuing capability incarnation.
Durable reservation provenance remains evidence only and cannot reconstruct transient execution authority.
Outcome observation/reconciliation remains allowed after process-generation loss because evidence is not effect authority.
architecture_delta.implementation_note: PID alone is insufficient as a durable identity because PID reuse exists. Prefer an opaque process-incarnation nonce reseeded after fork and checked together with process identity; exact mechanism must be tested for restart/fork/recovery semantics.
architecture_delta.rollback: Do not alter product semantics unless the exact target discriminator reproduces or another independent mechanism proves the same failure.
